title: Order line collection is exposed as a mutable list and a caller bypasses validation

consumerGuidance.architecture: Order owns its line collection. AddLine validates quantity against stock rules and recalculates the cached total.
consumerGuidance.notes: The cached Total is the value persisted and invoiced.

mustCite: the change of the Lines property from IReadOnlyList to List
the consequence that AddLine's quantity validation is skipped and the cached Total is left stale, so the persisted and invoiced amount excludes the added line
the correction of keeping the collection read-only and routing the admin path through AddLine

forbiddenFindings.example: Requiring a DDD aggregate root, domain events or a repository redesign.
Objecting to the property being auto-implemented or to member ordering.
Reporting the unrelated public setter on Order.Notes, which this change does not touch.

notes: The consequence is concrete because the cached total is what gets persisted and invoiced, not merely an encapsulation preference.
